title.en: KMP pattern DFA: prefix recovery on mismatch

summary: Derive transition behavior from a concrete pattern and explain why a mismatch can preserve a partial match.
objective: Build a KMP pattern DFA for ABABAC where stepping a text character reveals the matched prefix, mismatch fallback and first complete occurrence.
intent_signals: Build a KMP pattern DFA for ABABAC where stepping a text character reveals the matched prefix, mismatch fallback and first complete occurrence.
example_prompts: Build a KMP pattern DFA for ABABAC where stepping a text character reveals the matched prefix, mismatch fallback and first complete occurrence.
negative_signals: First occurrence only; no regex syntax, multi-pattern matching, grapheme segmentation or streaming all-overlap reporting. Pattern/alphabet limits are interface bounds, not complexity measurements.
not_for: First occurrence only; no regex syntax, multi-pattern matching, grapheme segmentation or streaming all-overlap reporting. Pattern/alphabet limits are interface bounds, not complexity measurements.

entities.name: Prefix ladder
entities.guidance: Place state cards in order with their full prefix labels and mismatch arrows routed in a separate labeled edge lane. Link to a text ribbon with consumed index; depth separates annotations only.

entities.name: Transition table
entities.guidance: Pin δ for the selected state beside the longest-suffix explanation, making repeated-prefix recovery visible without rereading consumed text.

state_contract.model: Declare a nonempty finite set of unique symbol IDs as the alphabet, nonempty pattern P of length m and text T as arrays of those symbol IDs. Indices and reported offsets count array symbols, not bytes or grapheme clusters. Reject duplicate alphabet declarations and out-of-alphabet input. Build the pattern DFA with states 0…m; j is matched-prefix length before the next input. For j<m, δ(j,c) is the longest prefix length k≤m whose prefix is a suffix of P[0:j]+c. Step is enabled only if i<|T| and j<m. Commit j←δ(j,T[i]), i←i+1; stop on j=m and report first-match start i−m. At text exhaustion with j<m report not-found without accessing T[i], including when the text is empty.
state_contract.authority: The typed domain model owns each committed state and result. Geometry, labels and selection derive from that model; animation cannot certify a claim.
actions: Edit pattern/alphabet and rebuild the table; reject empty pattern or out-of-alphabet symbols.
Step one text symbol and inspect the selected transition/table cell.
Compare ABABABAC against ABABAC, undo a consumed character and reset.

invariants: Exactly one transition exists per declared character in every nonterminal state; fallback is pattern-derived rather than an arbitrary edge.
For ABABABAC and pattern ABABAC, the first match starts at zero-based index 2.
Mismatch may retain a nonzero prefix. No next-character transition is performed after terminal state m in this first-match mode.
Empty text yields not-found without a character read. Exhaustion and a found match both disable further Step actions. Report offsets in the declared symbol-array indexing units.
motion_guidance: Step commits one semantic action; pause freezes presentation and leaves the committed state inspectable. Reset cancels pending playback and restores the complete starting state.
Offer a static transition highlight and an equivalent readable table for reduced motion. Camera travel is presentation, not an inference or domain operation.
creative_affordances: Use shallow sculptural cards, restrained materials and selective focus to expose relationships. Prefer a flat readable layout whenever depth has no declared role.
known_limits: First occurrence only; no regex syntax, multi-pattern matching, grapheme segmentation or streaming all-overlap reporting. Pattern/alphabet limits are interface bounds, not complexity measurements.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no generated artifact, solver integration, runtime behavior or visual check has run.

physical_contract.scope: Abstract symbols and logical state; mesh contact, light and motion have no causal role in the model.

object_craft.structure: Place state cards in order with their full prefix labels and mismatch arrows routed in a separate labeled edge lane. Link to a text ribbon with consumed index; depth separates annotations only.

claims.statement: The KMP pattern DFA precomputes mismatch transitions from a restart state and consumes text with table transitions until the first full pattern match or text exhaustion.
claims.scope: Finite declared alphabet and nonempty pattern; first-match semantics of the Princeton implementation.
